name: Mrs. D. K. Wade
role: Wife of rancher D. K. Wade
bio: Mrs. D. K. Wade lived with her husband at Tepee bottom, where a riding party from the paper called on them in July 1884, and where their young friend Miss Taylor of Boston came to spend the summer of 1885. In December 1886 she was visiting her mother in New Brighton, Pa.

moments.label: Her friend Miss Taylor came to spend the summer at Tepee bottom ranch

mentions: …er and several others. A cavalcade was formed and a ride to Tepee bottom with a pleasant call on Mr. and Mrs. Wade made an agreeable stopping point. The onward journey was through the Prairie-dog bottom and the saucy pertness of its ten thousand inhabitants was as comical as ever. Ou…
Miss Taylor, of Boston, a young friend of Mr. and Mrs. Wade came last Friday evening and will spend the summer at the Tepee bottom ranch.
Mrs. D. K. Wade has been in town for several days on a visit.
A mistake was made in last week's issue in stating that Mrs. D. K. Wade was in Faribault, Minn. She is in New Brighton, Penn., visiting her mother.
